final: WITH totals AS (SELECT SUM(traitcount) AS feature_total, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL), shares AS (SELECT f.zoneref AS site_code, f.traitcount AS feature_count, 1.0 * f.traitcount / t.feature_total AS share, 1.0 * f.traitcount / t.feature_total - 1.0 / t.record_count AS margin_above_average, f.traitregistry FROM scanfeatures AS f CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE f.traitcount IS NOT NULL) SELECT site_code, feature_count, share, margin_above_average FROM shares WHERE margin_above_average > 0 ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC, traitregistry LIMIT 10
